utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — do we know the exact time and location yet, and should I bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t know the exact time or place yet, but I can check on that. If you come, just bring yourself and maybe a few basic supplies if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Please check the time and place when you can, and if basic supplies are needed, let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll send my repair details over right away. Glad to hear there’s still room for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — just remind me and I’ll repeat the time and place for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’ll remind you when it’s time, and please keep it low-key for now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep it low-key and wait for your reminder, then I’ll repeat the time and place for folks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact date and time, and what items we’re fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the exact date and time yet, and I’m still waiting on the item list too. I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — please send it over as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — if you’ve got any repair to add, send it my way and I’ll put it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Nothing new from me yet — can you confirm the time and place when you have them?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the time and place as soon as they’re set and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m bringing the drill and a few screwdrivers, so just tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that should cover it. Let’s start with the porch light, and then we can look at the gate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — I’m still good for Saturday at 9. Send the repair drive details over when you can, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the repair drive details over. Just let me know if you need anything set up before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — I’m all set for now, and I’ll let you know if anything comes up before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — if you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know. I’m still hoping the porch light and that sticky gate get sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep checking on the repair drive and let you know as soon as I have the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’m hoping that porch light and the sticky gate get taken care of soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah — I’m heading out to ask around and sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I may need that reminder on the time and place later, since I can get a bit mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll remind you about the time and place when I get back, and I’ll check on the urgent repairs while I’m out.

utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it, Mara — send me the current supplies list and I’ll check what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — we still need a few extension cords, screwdrivers, pliers, and spare tape. If you can check on those, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll check on the extension cords, screwdrivers, pliers, and spare tape, and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — send me the list, and I’ll see which tools I can bring by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli — I’ll pass along whatever I hear. I’ve only got bits and pieces so far, but I’m glad to know you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s right — nothing new yet, but I’ll let you know the moment I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll help sort priorities and take one on. What repairs are highest priority right now?

utterances.text: Rey: The highest priorities are the broken front step and the leaking faucet. I’ll jot down the rest of the missing supplies and bring you the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll take the broken front step. Send me the supplies list when you can, and I’ll bring what I can for the faucet too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can pass along that the repair drive is Saturday morning around 9. If you want, I can also help coordinate anyone else who’s interested.

utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll start by sorting the urgent repairs and who can take each one. If you hear anyone else who wants to help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll send anyone interested your way, and I’ll keep the Saturday 9 repair drive details moving along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’d say start with a hammer, screwdriver set, adjustable wrench, and a tape measure — those usually cover most fixes. If you need anything else, I can bring it by.

utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Gus — those tools should cover most of what we’re fixing this Saturday at 10:00 a.m. in the community hall. Thanks for offering to bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Mara — I’ll bring those tools by for Saturday at 10:00 a.m. at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Mina — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies list and let you know if anything’s missing. Just tell me what’s already been gathered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. We’ve got a hammer, screwdriver set, adjustable wrench, and tape measure so far — what else do you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Looks like we’re still missing a few basics: screws, nails, duct tape, and maybe some spare batteries. If you can check for a utility knife and work gloves too, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the exact spot too, but I’ll check the community center lot and let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — thanks for checking. I’ll keep my ears open too and tell you if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah—thanks, Vik. I might need that reminder on the exact time and place later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Quinn. Yeah, the flyer would help, since I’m a bit forgetful about the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll bring a drill and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — that should help a lot. Send the repair drive details when you can, and I’ll keep Saturday at 9 on my calendar around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details soon, and Saturday at 9 still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’m ready when you are, and I’ll keep the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — I’ll share the repair drive details now, and we can keep it low-key.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
